title: Build a vowel from a pulse train and resonators
brief: Synthesize vowels the way the vocal tract does: an impulse train for the source and a cascade of two-pole formant resonators for the filter.
hints: Round each impulse position separately: np.round(np.arange(0, n_samples, sample_rate / f0)). Rounding the period once, before the loop, makes the pitch drift.
The resonator's denominator is a = [1, -2 * r * np.cos(theta), r * r], and its numerator is np.array([a.sum()]), which makes the gain at 0 Hz exactly 1.
r = np.exp(-np.pi * bandwidth / sample_rate). A factor of 2 pi in the exponent doubles the bandwidth.
Run the impulse train through scipy.signal.lfilter once per formant, then scale so np.max(np.abs(y)) is 0.5.
